title: Standard WOFOST rate-versus-state reconciliation

scope.purpose: close G03 without promoting legacy SAVE variables to physical state merely to reproduce implementation artifacts

source_evidence.source_wide_vernalization_search_result: vern/vernrate/fl_vernalised have no standard-route consumers outside the listed calculation, update and output sites

classifications.name: dtsum
classifications.proof: recomputed from current TAV and immutable DTSMTB on each daily phenology event before TSUM/DVS update; no cross-event read is required

classifications.name: dvr
classifications.proof: recomputed from current DVS, daylp, optional vernalization state, dtsum and immutable parameters on each daily event

classifications.name: daylp
classifications.proof: derived from current window astronomical forcing at day-start assimilation and consumed by the same window phenology calculation; no accepted-window continuation dependency exists

classifications.name: WOFOST_rates
classifications.proof: growth/death/allocation/leaf-age rates are calculated from committed crop origin plus current event inputs and consumed to form one candidate state; the next accepted crop event can recompute them

classifications.name: vernrate
classifications.proof_before_completion: while fl_vernalised is false, update_dvs_rate resets vernrate to zero and then assigns the current-day rate when DVS<VERNDVS; prior-day vernrate is therefore not a continuation input
classifications.legacy_after_completion: once fl_vernalised is true, update_dvs_rate no longer overwrites vernrate, yet task 3 still executes vern=vern+vernrate. A stale last rate can therefore continue changing the reported VERN value.
classifications.physical_feedback_after_completion: none found in the scoped standard route: fl_vernalised bypasses the vernalization reduction and VERN is subsequently only written as output
classifications.state_decision: do not promote vernrate into persistent physical crop state
classifications.compatibility_consequence: bitwise reproduction of the legacy post-vernalised VERN diagnostic may require a compatibility-only carryover or an explicitly qualified expected difference; this is not grounds for contaminating the physical continuation state with a rate

structural_candidate_rule: A future production candidate may keep all listed rates in worker/event workspace. If IDSL=2 is included in exact B1.10 output qualification, the candidate/VQ plan must explicitly cover the legacy stale-vernrate diagnostic behavior rather than silently persisting vernrate as crop state.
